about_the_game:
Rok Match - Expansion Pack

Optional, but highly recommended DLC that grants access to some features that was never available in the original multiplayer.

You will get:

  • Access to the custom Razor Wind weapon's code in Multiplayer.

  • Access to the custom Tranquilizer weapon's code in Multiplayer.

  • Access to the custom Sunfire Pod weapon's code in Multiplayer.

  • Access to the custom "Rocket Jump" code for the Rocket Launcher.

  • Access to one extra announcer taunt at the beginning of each new round (with a small chance of triggering).

  • Removal of the five-second startup delay in the custom launcher.

  • Ability to spectate other players in third person.

  • Ability to enter spectator mode directly from the game using the "spectate" console command.

  • Access to a music player for multiplayer with four play modes. You can load your own tracks or use default ones from single-player mode. Supported formats: MP3, WMA, WAV.

content_descriptors.notes: This game have content not appropriate for all ages: Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content.
